ruling_on_held_vs_published_category.ruling: Not sound as written; sound only in a narrowed form.
why: The publication rule holds a channel that has a verified audit when the detector suggests or applies the opposite sign or reports a conflict. That per-recording disagreement is how the AB04/i0 reversed pelvis was found.

The current test (logged hold reason + every published group matches the truth) never looks at the held group's own detector result. The hook always logs a hold reason, so the condition is nearly always true.
Crafted logs show knee_angle published +1 in one group and held in another where the detector suggests -1, applies -1, or reports a conflict: all three are marked explained, and the pilot would pass.
required_form: A held group explains the item only when its hold is not a sign disagreement, judged from structured log fields, not reason text.
Accept: the detector verdict is not 'conflict', and the detector sign is None or equals expected_sign for that group (power by its slot).
Accept as well: holds from a per-recording exception or a not-released channel.
Any held group whose detector opposes the truth or reports a conflict leaves the item unexplained, so the pilot fails and the item goes to review.
Add synthetic tests for the three contradicting cases (suggest opposite, apply opposite, conflict) and for the benign abstain hold.
